member_of.name: Versatile bill at Oscar Peterson Theatre (Tokyo)

podcast.title: Shared Bill in Japan
podcast.body: Alex Cuba was part of a "really versatile bill" that performed at the Oscar Peterson Theatre in Tokyo, Japan. This event also featured The Trews, Bedouin Soundclash, The Rural Alberta Advantage, and The Russian Futurists. "Alex Cuba. We went and did this like really versatile bill at the Oscar Peterson theater over in in Tokyo."

xref.title: Japan Trip with Canadian Artists (2008)
xref.body: In 2008, the band took a trip to Japan to play at the Canadian consulate, sharing a versatile bill at the Oscar Peterson Theatre in Tokyo with artists like Bedouin Soundclash, The Rural Alberta Advantage (then known as Wooden Hands), The Russian Futurists, and Alex Cuba. The venue's inability to accommodate their usual "heavy equipment, loud rock show" prompted their first significant acoustic performance. "we went and played at the consulate with like Bedouin Sound Clash and the band that ended to be the rural Alberta advantage."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Trews: In Their Own Words
